title: Regular Month-End Event Window
rationale: Tests whether a predeclared regular month-end exposure window can capture calendar-flow pressure without tuning entry or exit dates after seeing returns.
tests_claim: A fixed regular month-end event window may improve drawdown-adjusted behavior by holding only during scheduled flow windows and avoiding quarter-end overlap.
known_limitations: This is a single fixed event-window branch, not a month-end timing sweep.
The current workflow still needs a no-op calendar-path parameter so sweep/train-test validation can run through the default path.
The first SPY test weakened this exact full-window branch; campaign memory should block repeating opportunity=calendar_flow_pressure with template=calendar-month-end when that conclusion is present.
A successful result would support only the predeclared regular-month-end window, not arbitrary calendar seasonality.
